scope: harden /Users/ghost/core/secret/bin/secret to prevent token leak via stdout/agent logs
root_cause: Agent log capture of `secret get <key>` plaintext stdout was root cause #1 of 5 HF token exposures this session.

features_added.name: redact-by-default for `secret get`
features_added.redaction_impl: python3 hashlib via env-var passthrough (avoids piping plaintext through extra subshells)

features_added.name: `secret use <key> -- <command...>` env injection
features_added.behavior: exports SECRET_<SECTION>_<NAME> (uppercased, dots/dashes->underscores) AND a stable SECRET_VALUE alias, then exec's the command
features_added.isolation: child-only via export+exec (parent shell terminates implicitly because secret CLI is the parent process; env never appears in parent shell)
features_added.argv_safety: child command argv does NOT contain the value; only key name appears in `secret use`'s own argv (visible in ps for the lifetime of this wrapper, not the child)
features_added.stdout_safety: value never written to stdout/stderr by `secret use` itself

features_added.name: `--raw` opt-in plaintext flag
features_added.behavior: explicit `--raw` returns plaintext; reserved for piping into files (e.g. `secret get huggingface.token --raw > ~/.cache/huggingface/token`)
features_added.flag_position: before OR after the key (parser is order-tolerant)
features_added.unknown_flag_rejection: any other flag (including typos like `--Raw`) -> exit 2 with message

backwards_compat.BREAKING: all callers using bare `secret get <key>` will now receive the redacted hash instead of the plaintext token. existing scripts MUST add `--raw` (or migrate to `secret use`) to keep working.
backwards_compat.check_subcommand: rerouted to use the internal `_get_raw_value` helper directly so its existence-probe semantics are unaffected by the new redaction layer

user_actions_pending: decide migration strategy per file: (a) add `--raw` to existing $() captures, OR (b) refactor to `secret use <key> -- <command>` (preferred for env-injection cases that already exec a child)
re-source/re-run any long-lived shells if their muscle memory expects plaintext from `secret get`
update operator docs (docs/hf_token_canonical_baseline_2026_05_04.md uses bare `secret get` in 5 recipe lines — those recipes will break at the file-write step until --raw is added)
raw_invariants: raw#9 STRICT (Mac source = bash, edited in place)
raw#15 (synthetic test key, no real token in artifacts)
caveats: C1 BACKWARDS-COMPAT BREAKAGE: every existing caller using bare `secret get` will receive a redacted hash literal (~50 chars starting with `***REDACTED:`). HTTP Authorization headers, file dumps, and env exports built on bare $() will all silently authenticate-as-empty/garbage. callers_audit.jsonl lists 8 blocking sites that require --raw or `secret use` migration BEFORE next live invocation.

C2 ENV-VAR LEAKAGE VIA /proc: `secret use` exports SECRET_<KEY> and SECRET_VALUE into the child env. on macOS this is a child-process-only ACL (ps -E and `lsof -p PID` for the same UID can read it). on shared Linux hosts (ubu1, RunPod), `cat /proc/<child_pid>/environ` is readable by other processes of the same UID. NOT a concern on the local Mac, IS a concern if `secret use` is ported to / scp'd-to ubu1. mitigation: prefer pipe-to-stdin patterns (`secret get K --raw | child --token-from-stdin`) for shared-host deployments, or use `setenv`+`unsetenv` shims that scrub before exec.

C3 DEFAULT CHANGE NEEDS USER NOTIFICATION: any operator (human or agent) muscle-memory using `secret get huggingface.token` to inspect a token will see the hash and assume the vault is corrupted. surface a one-time announcement in any operator-facing doc and in the next session-start handoff.

C4 CALLERS AUDIT MAY MISS INLINE SUBSHELLS: the audit grep used `--include` extensions (.bash, .hexa, .py, .sh, .md, .json, .yml). dynamically generated shell strings (e.g. inside a hexa string-template that emits a runtime command line, or inside a Makefile, Dockerfile, .env script) may not appear. recommend a follow-up sweep with broader globs after the first session-end report (or at minimum an `ag 'secret get'` against ~/.claude/worktrees and any active sister repos).
